avis.texte: I have been using these drops every other night for a month and I love how gentle and soothing they are. Fragrance free and an amazing product for doing facial massages.

I use every night! Love this product! My skin feels moisturized and my skin soaks this up through the night!

Review of e.l.f. SKIN Youth Boosting Blue-ty Sleep Night Oil I've been using the e.l.f. SKIN Youth Boosting Blue-ty Sleep Night Oil as the final step in my nighttime skincare routine, and it has quickly become a favorite. This lightweight oil absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue, and just a few drops cover my entire face. It layers beautifully over moisturizer, making it easy to incorporate into any routine. The scent is very mild, which I appreciate since it doesn't interfere with sleep. I also love the convenient dropper, which makes application mess free and precise. By morning, my skin consistently feels soft, hydrated, and noticeably smoother. After using it regularly, I've noticed my complexion looks more refreshed and healthy when I wake up. ￼
feels great on the skin amazing for my dry skin leaves me feeling hydrated!

I bought this for the first time and I've only been using it for a week. I haven't seen any difference yet but it's light, and blends in well. It doesn't feel greasy and seems to melt into my face by bedtime so there's no residue on my pillow. I'm reserving judgment until the bottle is empty to give it a full review.

avis.titre: Best face oil I've ever used

avis.titre: Good introduction to retinoids into skincare routi
avis.texte: Unfortunately, I wasn't able to try this product myself, as I found out I was pregnant shortly after receiving it and chose to avoid retinoids during pregnancy. However, I did pass it along to a friend in exchange for her honest feedback—and overall, her experience was quite positive. She noticed a visible reduction in some of her finer lines and appreciated that the oil-based formula had a smooth dry-down without feeling sticky, which can be a common issue with similar products. Although she has very sensitive skin and experienced some redness around her nose, it subsided quickly and didn't cause any major irritation—especially compared to other products she's tried. All in all, this seems like a great option for anyone looking to gently introduce retinoids into their skincare routine.
